page_title: TOR 2-1 GEN | Torino v Genoa 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.

90+5' A nice lofted cross finds Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
90+4' The free kick from long range, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' 2 - 1 Valentino Lazaro produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Guillermo Maripan (Torino) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the top of the net. What a brilliant finish. 2:1.
90' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
89' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
87' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Morten Thorsby and he is replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
87' The substitution is prepared. Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruslan Malinovskyi.
86' Duvan Zapata (Torino) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

84' What a chance that is! Cesare Casadei (Torino) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
84' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

84' An accurate cross finds its way to Cesare Casadei (Torino) who sends in a bullet header towards the top of the net from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Duvan Zapata (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giovanni Simeone.
81' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the long-range free kick from Saul Coco (Torino).
78' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) replaces Stefano Sabelli.
78' Morten Frendrup will be replaced by Jean Onana (Genoa).

77' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Kevin Bonacina with no other option than to blow for a foul.
76' The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.

75' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Nicola Leali has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
74' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
73' It will be a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Che Adams walks off.
71' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
71' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
69' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
68' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
67' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Giovanni Simeone (Torino) commits a foul after dangerous play.
63' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the left post of his own goal.
61' Today's match ends for Jeff Ekhator who will be replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
60' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge (Torino) in, Nikola Vlasic out.
60' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Valentino Lazaro (Torino) replacing Cristiano Biraghi.
60' Kristjan Asllani comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ardian Ismajli (Torino).
59' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
58' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
58' Cesare Casadei (Torino) steps up to send the ball in.
56' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
54' A lofted cross from Che Adams (Torino) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
54' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) sees a yellow card from Kevin Bonacina after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
53' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a throw-in.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa. Saul Coco (Torino) reacts quickest to a cross from Cristiano Biraghi, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

44' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
43' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
40' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

39' Well-positioned Guillermo Maripan (Torino) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Nicola Leali reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
39' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.

37' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Torino.
37' 54:46 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
33' Adrien Tameze (Torino) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

32' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
29' Cesare Casadei (Torino) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Kevin Bonacina didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
27' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
25' Che Adams (Torino) jumps into a tackle and Kevin Bonacina signals a foul.
23' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Kevin Bonacina who sees an offensive foul.
23' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

20' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

20' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Morten Thorsby (Genoa) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

18' The free kick from long distance is taken by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Cesare Casadei (Torino) was too aggressive in his challenge. Genoa have a free kick.
15' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. It's a throw-in for Torino.

12' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.

11' A cross by Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball has crossed the sideline. Torino are taking a throw-in.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Morten Thorsby (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
7' Che Adams (Torino) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
5' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
5' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
4' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
2' Cesare Casadei (Torino) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Kevin Bonacina stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
